decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.08 across row_count 5000 (roughly 400 rows), so exact duplicate rows are removed keeping one instance per full-row match.
order_id has distinct_count 4000 and combined with line_no (distinct_values 1-7, null_rate 0.0) forms a plausible one-row-per-order-line grain; both are required non-drop columns.

status has only 5 distinct_values (CANCELLED, Shipped, cancelled, pending, shipped) covering 3 semantic states with inconsistent casing; normalization is deferred to review rather than silently collapsed here.
is_gift's distinct_values {N,Y,no,yes} are inconsistent encodings of the same boolean concept with null_count 60, so a derived is_gift_flag is added while the raw column is retained for audit.
qty samples mix negative integers, decimals, and the word three, so no numeric cast is safe; null_count is 10 (null_rate 0.002).
ship_date samples show at least five incompatible date formats plus a TBD placeholder and null_rate 0.264, so no single DATE cast is safe.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true and are capture-tool fields with no business meaning.
customer_email (null_rate 0.97) and notes (null_rate 0.61) are sparsely populated but retained nullable per rule 7 rather than dropped.

purpose: This table holds cleaned order-line records from the legacy POS system, one row per order line, feeding downstream order and revenue reporting.
usage: Consumers should join on order_id and line_no as the declared grain, treat qty and ship_date as raw text requiring their own parsing since formats are inconsistent in the source, and use is_gift_flag rather than the raw is_gift column when a boolean is needed; status values should be case-normalized by the consumer until a canonical mapping is agreed.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.08 of 5000 rows) are dropped, but qty and ship_date remain unparsed free text because samples show mixed numeric/textual and mixed date formats respectively; customer_email (null_rate 0.97) and notes (null_rate 0.61) are largely absent and status casing is not normalized.
